title: "Combined Correlation Trend Analysis"
subtitle: "Comparing validation across ADNI/AIBL, CSF pTau, and CSF Total Tau"
editor_options:
  chunk_output_type: console
---

## Overview

This analysis combines correlation results from multiple validation cohorts (ADNI/AIBL, CSF pTau, CSF Total Tau) to visualize how effect size correlations between AGES and external studies change across association P-value thresholds.

```{r}
#| label: load-packages
#| echo: false

# Additional packages (tidyverse, here, glue loaded via .Rprofile)
pacman::p_load(ggtext, ggh4x, scales, install = FALSE)

conflicted::conflict_prefer_all("dplyr", quiet = TRUE)
```

## Load and Combine Correlation Data

Load correlation results from individual validation analyses and combine into a single dataset.

```{r}
#| label: load-data

# Load and combine datasets with dataset identifier
combined_data <- bind_rows(
  read_rds(here("validation/output/correlation_results_ADNI_AIBL.rds")) |>
    mutate(dataset = "ADNI/AIBL Meta-analysis"),
  read_rds(here("validation/output/correlation_results_CSF_pTau_CN.rds")) |>
    mutate(dataset = "CSF pTau (CN)"),
  read_rds(here("validation/output/correlation_results_CSF_total_Tau_CN.rds")) |>
    mutate(dataset = "CSF Total Tau (CN)")
)

glimpse(combined_data)
```

## Prepare Data for Faceted Plot

Filter to key dementia transitions and reshape data for visualization.

```{r}
#| label: prepare-data

# Filter to three key transitions and create metrics
three_transitions <- c("prev", "mci2incid", "normal2incid")

plot_data <- combined_data |>
  filter(demcat %in% three_transitions) |>
  mutate(
    demcat = fct_relevel(demcat, "normal2incid", "mci2incid", "prev"),
    neg_log10_cor_pval = -log10(cor_pval),
    dataset = factor(dataset, levels = c(
      "ADNI/AIBL Meta-analysis",
      "CSF Total Tau (CN)",
      "CSF pTau (CN)"
    ))
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(cor_estimate, neg_log10_cor_pval, n_cpgs),
    names_to = "metric",
    values_to = "value"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    metric = fct_recode(metric,
      "Correlation Coefficient (<i>r</i>)" = "cor_estimate",
      "-log10(Correlation <i>P</i>)" = "neg_log10_cor_pval",
      "N CpG sites" = "n_cpgs"
    ),
    metric = fct_relevel(metric, "Correlation Coefficient (<i>r</i>)", "-log10(Correlation <i>P</i>)", "N CpG sites")
  )

glimpse(plot_data)
```

## Faceted Plot

### Three separate datasets

This plot shows how the correlation between AGES and validation datasets changes across significance thresholds. Each row represents a validation dataset, and each column shows a different metric.

```{r}
#| label: fig-correlation-trend-combined
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 8

faceted_plot <- plot_data |>
  ggplot(aes(x = cutoff_value, y = value, color = demcat)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  facet_grid2(dataset ~ metric, scales = "free", independent = "all") +
  scale_x_reverse(breaks = c(4.5, 4, 3.5, 3, 2.5, 2)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  labs(
    x = "-log10(Association <i>P</i>-value) Threshold",
    y = NULL,
    color = "Dementia Category"
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5),
    strip.text = element_markdown(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_markdown(),
    panel.spacing = unit(0.8, "lines")
  )

print(faceted_plot)
```

### Two datasets, ADNI/AIBL and CSF pTau

```{r}
#| label: fig-correlation-trend-two-datasets
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 6

two_dataset_ptau_plot <- plot_data |>
  filter(dataset != "CSF Total Tau (CN)", metric != "N CpG sites") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = cutoff_value, y = value, color = demcat, linetype = dataset)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  facet_wrap(vars(metric), scales = "free") +
  scale_x_reverse(breaks = c(4.5, 4, 3.5, 3, 2.5, 2)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  labs(
    x = "-log10(Association <i>P</i>-value) Threshold",
    y = NULL,
    color = "Dementia Transitions",
    linetype = "Study"
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = c(0.65, 0.7),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5),
    strip.text = element_markdown(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_markdown(),
    panel.spacing = unit(0.8, "lines")
  )

print(two_dataset_ptau_plot)
```

### Two datasets, ADNI/AIBL and CSF Total Tau

```{r}
#| label: fig-correlation-trend-two-datasets-total-tau
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 6

two_dataset_total_tau_plot <- plot_data |>
  filter(dataset != "CSF pTau (CN)", metric != "N CpG sites") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = cutoff_value, y = value, color = demcat, linetype = dataset)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5) +
  facet_wrap(vars(metric), scales = "free") +
  scale_x_reverse(breaks = c(4.5, 4, 3.5, 3, 2.5, 2)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  labs(
    x = "-log10(Association <i>P</i>-value) Threshold",
    y = NULL,
    color = "Dementia Transitions",
    linetype = "Study"
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = c(0.65, 0.7),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5),
    strip.text = element_markdown(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_markdown(),
    panel.spacing = unit(0.8, "lines")
  )

print(two_dataset_total_tau_plot)
```

## Export Figures

Save correlation trend figures as PNG and RDS files for manuscript and downstream use.

```{r}
#| label: save-figures

# Save three-dataset combined correlation trend plot (png and rds)
ggsave(
  here("validation/output/fig_correlation_trend_combined.png"),
  faceted_plot,
  width = 10,
  height = 8,
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white",
  device = ragg::agg_png
)
write_rds(faceted_plot, here("validation/output/fig_correlation_trend_combined.rds"))

# Save two-dataset plot (ADNI/AIBL + CSF pTau)
ggsave(
  here("validation/output/fig_correlation_trend_ADNI_AIBL_CSF_pTau.png"),
  two_dataset_ptau_plot,
  width = 10,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white",
  device = ragg::agg_png
)
write_rds(two_dataset_ptau_plot, here("validation/output/fig_correlation_trend_ADNI_AIBL_CSF_pTau.rds"))

# Save two-dataset plot (ADNI/AIBL + CSF Total Tau)
ggsave(
  here("validation/output/fig_correlation_trend_ADNI_AIBL_CSF_total_Tau.png"),
  two_dataset_total_tau_plot,
  width = 10,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white",
  device = ragg::agg_png
)
write_rds(two_dataset_total_tau_plot, here("validation/output/fig_correlation_trend_ADNI_AIBL_CSF_total_Tau.rds"))

message("Figures saved to validation/output/")
```
